common.loadError: This could not load. Check your connection and try again.
common.hrOnlyBody: Ask an HR admin or a workspace admin if you need access.

directory.desc: {count, plural, =0 {Nobody here yet} one {# person in your workspace} other {# people in your workspace}}
directory.search: Search by name, title or team
directory.emptyBody: Everyone in your workspace shows up here. HR can also add people who have not joined yet.
directory.emailHint: If they are already in the workspace, the profile links to their account.
directory.countryHint: Sets the public holidays for their time off.

profile.deleteBody: {name}'s profile, time off, documents and reviews are deleted. Their reports move to their manager. To record that someone left, use Offboard instead.
profile.reports: {count, plural, one {# direct report} other {# direct reports}}

offboard.title: Offboard {name}
offboard.removeHint: Cuts their access to every app now: API keys, calendar hosting, chats, channels and shared items, the same as removing them in Settings › Members.

timeoff.desc: Request days off, approve your team and see who is out.
timeoff.workingDaysHint: Weekends and public holidays for your country do not count.
timeoff.noPolicies: No time off policies yet. HR sets them up in People settings.
timeoff.noProfile: You do not have a People profile in this workspace yet, so you cannot request time off.
timeoff.noAccrual: No balance: every day taken is recorded
timeoff.adjustHint: Positive adds days, negative removes them.

documents.fileHint: PDF, PNG, JPEG, WebP or DOCX, up to 15 MB.
documents.title: Title
documents.requireAck: Ask them to confirm they read it
documents.ackCount: {count, plural, one {# person read it} other {# people read it}}
documents.signNote: Files are private: only HR and the person they are shared with can open them. E-signature is not available yet; use the read confirmation for policies.

comp.title: Compensation
comp.privacy: Only HR and this person see this. Amounts are encrypted and every view is recorded.

onboarding.desc: Checklists for people who join or leave, with tasks for them, their manager, IT and HR.
onboarding.finished: {count, plural, one {# finished checklist} other {# finished checklists}}
onboarding.deleteBody: The template {name} is deleted. Checklists already started keep their tasks.
onboarding.noTasks: No tasks yet. Add the first one.
onboarding.offsetHint: Negative means before. 0 is that same day.

exit.title: Exit interview
exit.privacy: Only HR sees exit interviews. They are encrypted.

oneOnOne.title: Your 1:1 notes with {name}
oneOnOne.privacy: Only the two of you see these notes. HR does not.

org.canvas: Org chart. Drag or use the arrow keys to move, plus and minus to zoom.
org.help: Drag to move, Ctrl or Cmd with the wheel to zoom. Set managers on each profile.
org.emptyBody: Add people and set their managers: the chart builds itself.

reviews.desc: Review cycles with self, manager and peer reviews.
reviews.emptyBody: Create a cycle, set the questions and launch it: everyone gets their reviews to write.
reviews.emptyBodyMember: When HR launches a review cycle, your reviews show up here.
reviews.launched: Cycle launched. Reviewers got a notification.
reviews.closed: Cycle closed. People now see their manager review.
reviews.deleteBody: The cycle {name} and all its reviews are deleted.
reviews.draftHint: You can change the questions until you launch the cycle.
reviews.nothingVisible: No reviews you can see in this cycle.

reports.desc: Headcount, turnover, time off and tenure. Only HR sees this page.
reports.turnoverHint: People who left over average headcount.
reports.auditHint: Every view and change of compensation, personal data, documents, performance and exit interviews.

settings.title: People settings
settings.desc: Time off policies, holidays, custom fields, who sees what and HR admins.
settings.policiesHint: Every policy applies to everyone. The first year is prorated from the start date. A policy with requests is archived instead of deleted.
settings.holidaysHint: National public holidays for this year and the next. They do not count as days off for people in that country.
settings.noCustomHolidays: No holidays of your own yet.
settings.fieldsHint: Extra fields for every profile. Mark a field as sensitive to show it only to HR and the person.
settings.optionsHint: For lists: options separated by commas.
settings.sensitiveField: Sensitive: HR and the person only
settings.visibilityHint: Who in the workspace sees each field in the directory and profiles. HR and the person always see their own.
settings.alwaysPrivate: Compensation, personal data, ID numbers, emergency contacts, performance and exit interviews are always private.
settings.handbookCreated: Handbook created in Docs. Everyone is asked to read it.
settings.welcomeHint: Shown at the top of the welcome page, with their manager, team, first tasks and what to read.
settings.hrAdminsHint: HR admins manage profiles, time off, documents, compensation, reviews and reports. Workspace owners and admins are always HR admins.
settings.onlyAdmins: Only workspace owners and admins choose HR admins.

welcome.title: Welcome, {name}
welcome.desc: Everything for your first days at {workspace}.
welcome.noMessage: Your HR team has not written a welcome message yet.
welcome.noProfile: You do not have a People profile in this workspace yet.
welcome.noTasks: No tasks for you right now.

errors.unauthorized: You do not have access to People in this workspace.
errors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
errors.options_required: A list needs at least one option.
errors.invalid_dates: Check the dates: the end cannot be before the start.
errors.manager_cycle: That would make someone their own manager up the chain.
errors.already_exists: That person already has a profile.
errors.owner_profile: The workspace owner's profile cannot be deleted or offboarded.
errors.invalid_option: Pick one of the list options.
errors.invalid_currency: Use a three-letter currency code, like USD.
errors.half_day_not_allowed: Half days are only for single-day requests on policies that allow them.
errors.no_working_days: Those dates are all weekends or holidays.
errors.overlap: You already have a request for some of those days.
errors.not_pending: Someone already decided on this request.
errors.not_cancellable: This request can no longer be cancelled.
errors.no_profile: You need a People profile for that.
errors.not_editable: This review can no longer be changed.
errors.file_type: Use a PDF, PNG, JPEG, WebP or DOCX file.
errors.image_type: Use a PNG, JPEG, GIF, WebP or AVIF image.
errors.invalid_page: That Docs page does not exist in this workspace.
errors.storage_unavailable: File storage is not available right now.
errors.file_type_not_allowed: That file type is not allowed.
